items.title: Southeast Natural Gas Cash Vaults Near $7 as Heat Tests Pipeline Limits
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices vaulted across the Southeast and Gulf Coast Monday as capacity cuts and restrictions piled up on regional pipelines while a heat wave kept summer-like temperatures in place.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Rebound as September Cooling Demand Chases Record
items.summary: Natural gas futures rebounded Monday as hotter weekend forecasts pushed September cooling demand within striking distance of the all-time record. Near-record production and an approaching late month cooldown capped gains.

items.title: DOE Coal Orders Barely Dent Summer Natural Gas Demand as Court Questions Authority
items.summary: Rising US power demand is expanding natural gas’ role as a flexible fuel for electricity, but federal emergency orders extending the lives of aging coal plants are adding another complication to the pace of gas-to-power growth.

items.title: Industrial, Power Growth Drive Projections for Mexico Natural Gas Demand Jump
items.summary: Mexico’s Energy Ministry (Sener) has published its 2025–2039 hydrocarbons development plan, targeting an increase in natural gas production to keep pace with a projected 25% rise in domestic demand.

items.title: Natural Gas Prices Edge Higher on Export Strength, Lingering Southern Heat
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures ticked up at Monday’s midpoint as traders took stock of robust LNG volumes, steady production and mixed weather.

items.title: US Natural Gas Storage Picture Likely to Tighten Even as Henry Hub Slides
items.summary: Another bout of hotter-than-normal temperatures across the continental United States last week will likely lead to some meaningful changes in the Lower 48 storage supply balance, in our view.

items.title: As Weather Demand Lets Up, Weekly Natural Gas Spot Prices Fall in Most Regions
items.summary: Weekly natural gas cash prices gave up ground across a majority of the Lower 48 amid forecasts for increasingly mild temperatures and lighter cooling demand.

items.title: Tetco M-2 Falls Below $1.50 as Appalachian Natural Gas Enters Curtailment Season
items.summary: Appalachian natural gas prices are entering the autumn stretch that has pushed them below EQT’s $1.500/MMBtu trigger for output cuts in recent years, and this year the hub got there a week ahead of schedule.

items.title: Wealthy Investors Flock To Oil & Gas Assets Amid Energy Crisis
items.summary: The U.S. and global economies have continued to mint high-net-worth individuals at a historic clip, with wealth intelligence firm Altrata noting that the combined wealth of the world’s billionaires jumped 12.8% Y/Y to a record $15.1 trillion in 2025.
